name.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 1〜4次モーメントを独立正の積分で資格。既知分散による5SE校正、seed間分散、解析分散低減、重み欠落負例。既知分散normal95%のIS区間の被覆は閾値/prefixごと64反復で別記。
note.en: Qualify moments1..4 by independent positive quadrature. Gate known-variance5SE,batch variance,analytic variance reduction and omitted-weight negative control. Report known-variance normal95IScoverage separately for64trials per threshold/prefix.

name.ja: 正規稀少尾の通常importance sampling
name.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

note.ja: 解析解 標準正規尾a=3/6、proposal=N(a,1)、64独立seed、N=2048/8192の固定prefix。 重み付きISへBernoulliの厳密区間を転用しません。64反復は一般95%被覆の証明でなく、nestedprefixを独立反復へ水増ししません。global weightESSと事象ESSは別です。
note.en: Analytic reference Standard normal tailsa3/6;proposalN(a,1);64independent seeds;fixedN2048/8192prefixes. Bernoulli exact intervals are not applied to weighted IS.64trials do not prove general95%coverage;nested prefixes are not extra independent replicates. Global weightESS and eventESS are distinct.

name.en: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian — references and comparison conditions

note.ja: 4つのpreconditioned最終prefix全観測量にRhat/ESS/MCSE/既知moment条件。同じ128scalararrayを別ArviZ0.20過程へ渡した640値資格と全データSHAで照合。標的は解析Gaussianモーメントで別検査。 640比較は不変な同一データfixture上で行い、別に生成する8組のfresh軌道で物理・混合判定を行います。環境を跨ぐ生成配列のbit一致は要求しません。
note.en: Gate all full-prefix observables in4preconditioned chainsets by Rhat/ESS/MCSE/knownmoments. Match exact dataSHAand640values from128scalar arrays in a separateArviZ0.20process. Target law is separately checked by analytic Gaussian moments. All640comparisons use the immutable same-data fixture;8freshchainsets independently receive the unchanged physical/mixing gates. No portable generated-byte-identity claim.

name.en: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Mean(1,-1),unit marginal variances,rho.95;4independent chainsets×4chains;burn1024/draw8192;prefix2048/8192. Fixed.9Lzand.25z,no adaptation. Diagnostic-engine independence is not an independent sampler. Rhat/ESS/MCSE do not prove global convergence/coverage. Isotropic is descriptive with no required failure;banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSremain unimplemented.
